description: Signature Base64 decodes cleanly (mod-4 clean, standard alphabet, no whitespace) but yields 63 raw bytes instead of the Ed25519 signature length of exactly 64 bytes. The caller-side check in _verify_ed25519_signature rejects with 'Invalid Ed25519 signature length (expected 64 raw bytes)'. Under v0.9.0a2 this length check is unchanged from v0.8.3 but is now locked as a conformance vector.
source: Ed25519 signature-shape rule: decoded signature MUST be exactly 64 bytes. Base64 that decodes to any other length is rejected by the caller-side check in _verify_ed25519_signature (unchanged from v0.8.3 but locked here for cross-implementation conformance).
